differences.a_observable: The background tiles in the top-right corner are heavily blurred due to a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The background tiles are in sharp focus, indicating a much wider depth of field.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust focus distance to blur the background.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly button and blue Hyperswitch button have a distinct metallic bevel around their colored inserts.
differences.b_observable: The buttons lack this metallic bevel, appearing as flat colored shapes on the white tiles.
differences.fix: Add a metallic beveled frame material around the colored inserts of the buttons.

differences.a_observable: The white tiles and background have a cooler, blue-cyan color cast.
differences.b_observable: The white tiles are neutral grey and white with no color cast.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance or add a cool blue-cyan color grading to the scene.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust focus distance to match the reference's shallow depth of field.

differences.a_observable: The 'Live Now' button is absent immediately after the cut, animating into view later.
differences.b_observable: The 'Live Now' button is already present and static from the moment of the cut.
differences.fix: Delay the appearance of the 'Live Now' button and animate its entry to match the reference.

differences.a_observable: The card borders feature a brushed metallic material with realistic anisotropic reflections.
differences.b_observable: The card borders are flat grey with no metallic texture or reflections.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal material with appropriate roughness and reflectivity to the card borders.

differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the cards, creating a dynamic perspective with a shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further away, resulting in a flatter perspective and a wider field of view.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera position and focal length to match the closer, more dramatic framing of the reference.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Animate the 'Live Now' button to slide into place after the cut instead of having it static from the start.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette with darker corners compared to the center.

differences.fix: Add a vignette in post-production or adjust the light falloff.

differences.a_observable: Shallow depth of field blurs the background elements.
